note: tester.35 release manifest: every row moves to the tester.35 head of its line. bc250-win rows: main 7c868060 (the HIP wait spin and the llama asset builder with 1 GiB buffers). Mesa: the hosted line 68fc2035 (BD-216 single-file disk cache on Windows), the system line 5dea8835 and the wow64 line 17de7ab1 (the same change); the desktop, zink, CPU and OpenGL lines keep their tester.34 commits. dxvk b54b9402 (BD-216 pipeline compiles on the worker threads). vkd3d-proton keeps 47cf6771. Fork row bases are the tester.34 row commits, so that the attribution scan reads exactly the commits that are new since tester.34. The fork rows take their recipes from main 0e8ebe81. The HIP rows link a layer 1 library built from main (scratch/t35/release/hip-layer1). New row test: cache-win32 (the Windows disk cache tests of BD-216) on the hosted and system x64 lab rows.

outputs.pair_skew: The x86 system Vulkan row 17de7ab1 is the tester.34 wow64 line 9d8168c9 with the single-file disk cache on Windows (BD-216, 17de7ab1), and the x64 system row 5dea8835 is the tester.34 system line de66c413 with the same change. The tester.34 x86 line 9d8168c9 is the tester.33 wow64 line 20d7c8c9 with the BD-254 preamble and gather-slot fixes (cbe8dc03, f9191318, 771c666b), the BD-201 BO lifetime host test (d58067a4 to e7fb7053) and the fixes it shares with the x64 system line de66c413 (tester.33 line ad130cc2 with the same BD-201 test, 85486b52 to 874d30b2): the async compute threadgroup workaround on GFX1013 (x86 c0c1f240, x64 1f3f6938), the gfx1013 lowering of signed packed 4x8 dot products ported from dmorazasanchez/bc250-fsr4 v3 (x86 0f49b0ee to 8c452da1, x64 7ffc66ef to 67d3864e), driconf regular expressions on Windows, the process name at any path length, machine-profile driconf files, the per-application graphics settings, no GDS access without a GDS partition (BD-119), debugging variables read only in the lab flavour and the zstd 1.5.7 wrap. Only the x86 row reads MemoryOverflow and the WSI route switch in the 64-bit registry view (the x64 row reads that view natively). Only the x64 row has the compute-node border colour fix (3a5e0436) and the BD-212 fix that keeps the progress fence of a queue that goes with unretired work (fa4fadf7); the x64 row gets the instruction-prefetch padding (e92476c8) that the x86 line has had since before tester.33 (b3e45baf). The x86 settings reader uses the GDI-only WSI: MaxFrameLatency applies only to other GPUs on the DXGI path, and VSync 0 only skips the DWM wait. The x86 build does not port the x64 DXGI present or compute work.
